retention_decision: Reject the borrowed iterator prototype. Million-series broad resolution improves in all three pairs, but 100,000-series broad resolution is slower in all three. The candidate has 4.5% higher median paired latency there with narrowly overlapping ranges. Lower whole-process allocation traffic does not qualify a reliable latency improvement. Restore all three prototype source files byte for byte.
